name: Logs
description: A dataset of system/application logs intended to evaluate models on log understanding tasks such as anomaly detection, log-to-action or log-to-explanation mapping. Benchmarks typically require models to interpret log lines and produce diagnostic or corrective outputs.
evaluation_method: accuracy / exact_match for labeled tasks; may use F1 for imbalanced classes
reputation: A modest Hugging Face dataset within the NoCode-bench collection; limited but useful for specialized log understanding evaluations.
